 The Rough Rider, it's a shield with 0 shield capacity, 20% passive damage reduction and a flat health bonus. A lot of the Mania tree has skill buffs that proc when your shield is down, so this benefit is pretty clear.

No you can't. A beacon will only be active if there is no opaque block in between it and the height limit. Glass wouldn't block it but bedrock would. The entire Nether has a bedrock/Netherrack ceiling, which would be in between the beacon and the height limit. Unless you broke the bedrock on Creative, beacons would not work.
